title: Ordinary coefficient projection square
statement: Fix l,E,o,a, an arbitrary base B, input family X and ordinary integral inputs K. For a proper f:U→V and expressions e on U and t on V, the ordinary reduction of (S_f e) tensor t followed by system properProjection equals the reduction of the ringed proper projection followed by the ordinary reduction of S_f(e tensor P_f t).

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: Expand rightAdjointProjectionMap into its unit, tensor comparison, and counit. Apply the ordinary tensor and pullback comparison equations, then paste the unit and counit identities of the proper adjunction. Naturality inserts the coefficient maps of e and t, yielding the displayed projection equality without cartesianness or invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryProjectionSquare
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) :
    ∀ {U V : Over B} (f : U ⟶ V) (hf : IsProper f.left)
      (e : Expression B I X U) (t : Expression B I X V),
      (Expression.tensor (.push f hf e) t).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
        ((properProjection l E o f.left).app
          (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K))).app
            (t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
      (calculus l E V.left).reduction.map
          (((ringedProperProjection l E a.ringedModels f.left).app
            (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)).app (t.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
        (Expression.push f hf (.tensor e (.pull f t))).ordinaryReduction l E o a K
